question: What was the magnitude of the earthquake that hit Haixi prefecture of Qinghai in June 2026?

steps.content:
[June 16 Haixi Earthquake_Baiduwiki - 百度百科] According to the official measurement by the China Earthquake Networks Center, at 17:06 on June 16, 2026, a magnitude 6.3 earthquake occurred in the Haixi Prefecture Directly Administered Area of Qinghai Province , with a focal depth of 10 kilometers. The epicenter was located at 37.80 degrees north latitude and 95.56 degrees east longitude.
[June 16, 2026, Haixi Prefecture Directly Administered Region, Qinghai ...] At 17:06 on June 16, an earthquake with a magnitude of 6.3 occurred in the Directly Administered Region of Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province (37.80°N, 95.56°E), with a focal depth of 10 kilometers. As of 20:00 on June 16, the earthquake had resulted in 1 person killed and 4 injured.
[One dead, 4 injured after China's Qinghai hit by magnitude 6.3 ...] A magnitude 6.3 earthquake hit the northwestern Chinese province of Qinghai on Tuesday, killing at least one person and injuring four, as rescuers rushed to the site in search of trapped survivors.
The earthquake that hit Haixi Prefecture of Qinghai on June 16, 2026, had a magnitude of 6.3. FINAL: 6.3
